name: From the Sunset Coast: Ballad of Claw and Heart
source:
Archives of bad decisions and often the most depressing endings. How avoiding said endings can break a person down. What happens when substances fill the void, and how does one get better?

Learning to love after someone's abused said love is a struggle, one this Husky has to overcome before moving on to the next struggle...

[From [url=https://djmadeyevn.itch.io/balladofclawandheart]Itch.io[/url]]
